reason: Options 'Up to 250 or more'/'200 fixed' were muddled and explanation wrongly said party-list adds seats beyond 250; rewritten to the exact Art. VI Sec. 5(1) cap.

fields.text: Under Article VI, Section 5(1) of the 1987 Constitution, the House of Representatives shall be composed of not more than how many members, unless otherwise fixed by law?
fields.explanation: Article VI, Section 5(1) of the 1987 Constitution provides that the House shall have not more than 250 members, unless otherwise fixed by law. This total already includes party-list representatives, who make up 20% of the House under Section 5(2).
fields.hint: Recall the number written in Article VI, Section 5(1); don't confuse it with the Senate.
fields.whyB: 200 is a round-number guess; the figure written in Section 5(1) is 250.
fields.whyC: 24 is the number of Senators (Art. VI, Sec. 2), not House members.
fields.whyD: 300 is not in the Constitution; Congress may change the size by law, but the stated cap is 250.
fields.explanationTl: Sabi ng Article VI, Section 5(1) ng 1987 Constitution, hindi hihigit sa 250 ang members ng House, unless otherwise fixed by law. Kasama na diyan ang party-list representatives, na 20% ng House under Section 5(2).
fields.hintTl: Alalahanin ang number sa Article VI, Section 5(1); huwag ipagkamali sa Senate.

fields.hint: The symbol comes from sodium's Latin name, not its English name.
fields.whyB: 'So' just takes the first two letters of the English name.
fields.whyC: 'Sd' is a made-up abbreviation of 'sodium'; no element uses it.
fields.explanationTl: Ang chemical symbol ng sodium ay Na, galing sa Latin name nito na natrium.
fields.hintTl: Galing sa Latin name ng sodium ang symbol, hindi sa English.

fields.hint: Think of the country whose flag shows a red sun disc.
fields.whyA: China lies west of Japan and is not called the Land of the Rising Sun.
fields.whyC: South Korea is called the 'Land of the Morning Calm', a common mix-up.
fields.whyD: Thailand is known as the 'Land of Smiles'.
fields.explanationTl: Tinatawag na 'Land of the Rising Sun' ang Japan kasi nasa silangan ito, kung saan sumisikat ang araw; ang Nihon o Nippon ay ibig sabihin 'origin of the sun'.
fields.hintTl: Isipin ang bansa na may pulang bilog na araw sa flag.

fields.hint: It is the zero point of the Celsius scale.
fields.whyB: 100°C is the boiling point of water at sea level, not freezing.
fields.whyC: -10°C is below freezing; water is already ice there, but it starts freezing at 0°C.
fields.whyD: 50°C is warm liquid water, nowhere near freezing.
fields.explanationTl: Nagyeyelo ang tubig sa 0°C sa sea level, under standard atmospheric pressure.
fields.hintTl: Ito yung zero point ng Celsius scale.

fields.hint: The painter was a Dutch post-impressionist famous for swirling brushstrokes and 'Sunflowers'.
fields.whyA: Monet was a French impressionist known for 'Water Lilies', not 'The Starry Night'.
fields.whyD: Dali, a surrealist, painted 'The Persistence of Memory'.
fields.explanationTl: Si Vincent van Gogh ang nagpinta ng 'The Starry Night' noong 1889, isang sikat na post-impressionist na obra.
fields.hintTl: Dutch post-impressionist siya, sikat sa paikot-ikot na brushstrokes at sa 'Sunflowers'.

fields.hint: It is the gas we inhale and our cells use to release energy from food.
fields.whyA: Hydrogen is in water and food molecules but is not the gas we breathe in for respiration.
fields.whyC: Nitrogen is the most abundant gas we inhale, but the body does not use it in respiration; we exhale it unchanged.
fields.whyD: Carbon leaves the body as carbon dioxide, a waste product of respiration.
fields.explanationTl: Oxygen ang kailangan sa human respiration; ginagamit ito ng cells para makagawa ng energy.
fields.hintTl: Ito yung gas na nilalanghap natin at ginagamit ng cells para kumuha ng energy sa pagkain.

reason: Key correct; explanation clarified that Abuja replaced Lagos as capital in 1991.

fields.explanation: Abuja is the capital of Nigeria; the planned city, built in the 1980s, officially replaced Lagos as the capital in 1991.
fields.hint: The capital is a planned city in the center of the country, not the biggest city.
fields.whyA: Lagos is Nigeria's largest city and former capital, but not the current capital.
fields.whyC: Kano is a major northern city, not the capital.
fields.whyD: Ibadan is a large southwestern city, not the capital.
fields.explanationTl: Abuja ang capital ng Nigeria; planned city ito na itinayo noong 1980s at pinalitan ang Lagos bilang capital noong 1991.
fields.hintTl: Planned city sa gitna ng bansa ang capital, hindi yung pinakamalaking city.

fields.hint: It is a single capital letter.
fields.whyB: 'Ox' is a common abbreviation guess but not the chemical symbol.
fields.explanationTl: Ang chemical symbol ng oxygen ay O sa periodic table.

fields.whyA: Wind drives wind turbines, which is wind power, not hydropower.
fields.whyB: The sun ultimately drives the water cycle, but the direct source for hydropower is moving water; solar power uses sunlight.
fields.whyD: Geothermal power uses heat from inside the Earth.
fields.explanationTl: Ginagamit ng hydropower ang energy ng gumagalaw na tubig para gumawa ng kuryente.
fields.hintTl: Ang ibig sabihin ng 'hydro' ay tubig.

fields.hint: The author also wrote 'El Filibusterismo' and is the national hero.
fields.whyA: Ferdinand Marcos was a 20th-century president, not a Propaganda-era novelist.
fields.whyC: Mabini, the 'Brains of the Revolution', wrote 'El Verdadero Decalogo', not the Noli.
fields.whyD: Bonifacio founded the Katipunan; he did not write the Noli.
fields.explanationTl: Si Jose Rizal ang sumulat ng 'Noli Me Tangere', nobela na naglantad ng pang-aabuso ng Spanish colonial rule sa Pilipinas.
fields.hintTl: Siya rin ang sumulat ng 'El Filibusterismo' at siya ang national hero.

fields.hint: Choose the gas that is much lighter than air and does not burn.
fields.whyA: Oxygen is slightly denser than air, so it will not lift a balloon.
fields.whyC: Nitrogen is about as dense as air, so the balloon will not rise.
fields.whyD: Carbon dioxide is heavier than air; a CO2 balloon sinks.
fields.explanationTl: Helium ang ginagamit kasi mas magaan ito kaysa hangin, kaya lumulutang ang balloon.
fields.hintTl: Piliin ang gas na mas magaan kaysa hangin at hindi nasusunog.

fields.hint: Nitrogen is first at about 78%; which gas is next?
fields.whyA: Nitrogen is the MOST abundant (about 78%), not the second.
fields.whyC: Carbon dioxide is only about 0.04% of the atmosphere.
fields.explanationTl: Oxygen ay mga 21% ng atmosphere ng Earth, pangalawa sa nitrogen.
fields.hintTl: Nitrogen ang una sa mga 78%; ano ang sunod?

reason: Key correct; explanation now notes the mango is traditionally recognized, not declared by law.

fields.explanation: The mango, especially the 'carabao' variety, is widely recognized as the national fruit of the Philippines, although unlike the flag and anthem it is not declared by law.
fields.hint: Think of the sweet yellow fruit Guimaras is famous for.
fields.whyB: Banana is a major Philippine export, but it is not the national fruit.
fields.whyC: Coconut is called the 'tree of life' and is a top crop, but it is not the national fruit.
fields.whyD: Pineapple is widely grown in Mindanao, but it is not the national fruit.
fields.explanationTl: Ang mangga, lalo na yung 'carabao' variety, ay kilala bilang national fruit ng Pilipinas, kahit hindi ito idineklara by law gaya ng flag at anthem.
fields.hintTl: Isipin ang matamis na dilaw na prutas na sikat sa Guimaras.
